capabilities: Copy block links, embeds, and Obsidian URIs for blocks and headings
Create multi-line range blocks with ^id-id format
Treat list items as outliner blocks in scoped files with blp-view queries
Edit embedded blocks and headings inline in Live Preview
View multiple Daily Notes in one continuous journal feed
disambiguation: Beyond copying block links, it also adds a Logseq-like outliner mode and a multi-Daily-Notes journal feed view.
extras: Full documentation lives on an external site linked from the README; the README notes that legacy Timeline / Time Section features were removed in version 2.0.
problem: Obsidian's built-in block references only cover single blocks, with no multi-line range blocks, no easy copy commands, and no list-item-as-block outliner workflow.

relations.evidence: sync-embeds - Leaf-based inline edit engine foundation

summary: Block-link toolkit that copies links, embeds and URIs to blocks and headings, creates multi-line range blocks, and adds a Logseq-style outliner.
